requirement: Host detached signature over a canonical release manifest; target verification and Windows Authenticode are separate capabilities.
Evaluate pure ML-DSA-87 from FIPS 204 for the first experiment. Selection is candidate, not CNSA conformance.
Sign domain-bound canonical manifest bytes, not rendered text or path names. Define encoding and serialization before key generation.
Bind immutable source/build identity, artifact SHA-256 and byte count, version, destination hardware and policy ID/hash.
Separate disposable research keys from production key ceremony; no production keys generated by inventory runner.
Pin public-key identity through approved trust provisioning outside the artifact package; included public key alone is not a trust anchor.
Verify signature, issuer authorization, target binding and rollback floor separately; valid signature never authorizes installation automatically.
Reject unknown algorithms, parameter mismatch, missing required signatures and unauthorized fallback to classical verification.
Design key revocation, expiry, rotation and recovery with independent authorization and retained evidence.
Lock executable, library/provider versions and implementation provenance before executing cryptographic operations.
Require known-answer/interoperability vectors plus altered manifest/artifact/signature, wrong key/context and truncated signatures.
PQC detached signatures must not be forced into the 06J fixed 64-byte NodeLink field; define separate versioned artifact format.
Measure verification flash/RAM/stack/latency on exact F401/NXP targets before embedded integration.
Compare LMS/XMSS firmware verification as alternatives; signer state safety, one-time-key reuse and backup/restore risks require separate design.
Record dependencies, licenses, hashes, SBOM and security fixes for the selected provider.
Do not assert PQC acceleration or nonextractable keys from chip names; require exact vendor evidence.
Retain EU requirement mapping separately. PQC alone does not demonstrate machinery safety or EU conformity.
Determine NSS deployment/contract scope before assigning mandatory CNSA deadlines. Guidance is not automatic project applicability.
Preserve exact inputs, logs, verification outcomes and negative cases; successful inventory is not successful signature verification.
Keep 06J Windows execution unadjudicated until evidence arrives; preserve existing 575 files and all physical project debts.
